research.title: Intent Classification for Customer Support Requests
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by removing duplicates, standardizing text fields, and checking label consistency across predefined training and evaluation partitions.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines using an established evaluation protocol, inspecting confusion matrices for errors between closely related request categories.

research.title: Sentence-Level Classification of Scientific Abstracts
bullets: Cleaned abstract text, checked sentence boundaries, and organized rhetorical labels while preserving document-level separation between training and evaluation sets.
Implemented bag-of-words and linear support vector machine baselines, comparing feature configurations and reviewing misclassifications involving background, methods, and conclusion sentences.

work.title: Routine Operations and Records Support
bullets: Maintained routine inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against order documentation, and referred discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Organized physical records, prepared materials for daily activities, and communicated scheduling changes and outstanding supply requests during shift handovers.

projects.title: Lexical Baselines for Duplicate Question Detection
bullets: Implemented a baseline classifier for question pairs using token overlap, length differences, and cosine similarity between TF-IDF representations.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out partition and inspected false matches involving shared vocabulary but different requested information.

projects.title: Frequency-Based Extractive Document Summarization
bullets: Implemented a sentence-ranking baseline using normalized term frequencies, with stopword filtering and source-order preservation when assembling extractive summaries.
Compared generated summaries with a lead-sentence baseline using reference overlap measures and manually reviewed redundancy and missing context.
